content.json:
## Storage Account Geo-Replication Monitoring

This workbook monitors geo-replication lag for Azure Storage Accounts.

### Overview - Summary Statistics

Key metrics at a glance:

queries.query:
StorageGeoReplication_CL
| where ServiceType_s_s == "StorageGeoReplication"
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SubscriptionId_s_s, ResourceName_s_s
| summarize 
    TotalAccounts = count(),
    GeoReplicated = countif(IsGeoReplicated_b_b == true),
    NotGeoReplicated = countif(IsGeoReplicated_b_b == false),
    WithReadAccess = countif(HasReadAccess_b_b == true),
    OverThreshold = countif(IsOverThreshold_b_b == true),
    Healthy = countif(HasReadAccess_b_b == true and IsOverThreshold_b_b == false)
| extend 
    GeoReplicationPercentage = round((GeoReplicated * 100.0 / TotalAccounts), 1),
    HealthPercentage = round((Healthy * 100.0 / WithReadAccess), 1)
| project 
    TotalAccounts = strcat('Total Storage Accounts: ', TotalAccounts),
    GeoReplicated = strcat('Geo-Replicated: ', GeoReplicated, ' (', GeoReplicationPercentage, '%)'),
    NotGeoReplicated = strcat('Not Geo-Replicated: ', NotGeoReplicated),
    WithReadAccess = strcat('With Read Access (Monitored): ', WithReadAccess),
    OverThreshold = strcat('⚠️ Over Threshold: ', OverThreshold),
    Healthy = strcat('✅ Healthy: ', Healthy, ' (', HealthPercentage, '%)')
queries.name: Query 1

content.json: ### Storage Accounts with Geo-Replication Enabled (with Lag Status)

queries.query:
StorageGeoReplication_CL
| where ServiceType_s_s == "StorageGeoReplication"
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where IsGeoReplicated_b_b == true
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SubscriptionId_s_s, ResourceName_s_s
| project TimeGenerated, SubscriptionId_s_s, ResourceGroup_s_s, ResourceName_s_s, 
         Location = PrimaryLocation_s_s, SkuName_s_s, GeoReplicationStatus_s_s,
         LagMinutes_d_d, ThresholdMinutes_d_d, IsOverThreshold_b_b
| order by IsOverThreshold_b_b desc, LagMinutes_d_d desc nulls last
queries.name: Query 2

queries.query:
StorageGeoReplication_CL
| where ServiceType_s_s == "StorageGeoReplication"
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where IsGeoReplicated_b_b == true
| where HasReadAccess_b_b == true
| where IsOverThreshold_b_b == true
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SubscriptionId_s_s, ResourceName_s_s
| project TimeGenerated, SubscriptionId_s_s, ResourceGroup_s_s, ResourceName_s_s,
         Location = PrimaryLocation_s_s, SkuName_s_s, GeoReplicationStatus_s_s,
         LagMinutes_d_d, ThresholdMinutes_d_d
| extend LagOverThreshold = LagMinutes_d_d - ThresholdMinutes_d_d
| order by LagOverThreshold desc
queries.name: Query 3

content.json:
### Historical Lag Analysis (Last 30 Days) - Priority Blob Replication Prioritization

This analysis identifies subscriptions with historical lag issues, even if currently synced. Helps prioritize Priority Blob Replication based on past performance patterns.

queries.query:
let HistoricalData = StorageGeoReplication_CL
| where ServiceType_s_s == "StorageGeoReplication"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where IsGeoReplicated_b_b == true
| where HasReadAccess_b_b == true
| where isnotnull(LagMinutes_d_d);
let CurrentData = HistoricalData
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SubscriptionId_s_s, ResourceName_s_s;
HistoricalData
| summarize 
    SubscriptionId = any(SubscriptionId_s_s),
    TotalDataPoints = count(),
    TimesOverThreshold = countif(IsOverThreshold_b_b == true),
    TimesOverThresholdPercent = round((countif(IsOverThreshold_b_b == true) * 100.0 / count()), 1),
    MaxLagEver = round(max(LagMinutes_d_d), 2),
    AvgLag = round(avg(LagMinutes_d_d), 2),
    P95Lag = round(percentile(LagMinutes_d_d, 95), 2),
    P99Lag = round(percentile(LagMinutes_d_d, 99), 2)
    by SubscriptionId_s_s
| join kind=inner (
    CurrentData
    | summarize CurrentLag = round(avg(LagMinutes_d_d), 2), CurrentStatus = any(IsOverThreshold_b_b) by SubscriptionId_s_s
) on SubscriptionId_s_s
| extend HistoricalPriorityScore = round((MaxLagEver * 0.3) + (AvgLag * 0.2) + (P95Lag * 0.2) + (TimesOverThresholdPercent * 0.3), 2)
| extend PriorityRecommendation = case(
    HistoricalPriorityScore > 50 or TimesOverThresholdPercent > 30, "🔴 High Priority - Frequent lag issues, consider Priority Blob Replication",
    HistoricalPriorityScore > 25 or MaxLagEver > 20, "🟡 Medium Priority - Occasional lag spikes, monitor closely",
    HistoricalPriorityScore > 10, "🟢 Low Priority - Minor lag, standard replication OK",
    "✅ Healthy - No significant lag history")
| extend LagHistorySummary = strcat("Max: ", MaxLagEver, " min | Avg: ", AvgLag, " min | Over threshold: ", TimesOverThresholdPercent, "% of time")
| order by HistoricalPriorityScore desc, MaxLagEver desc, TimesOverThresholdPercent desc
| project SubscriptionId, TotalDataPoints, TimesOverThreshold, TimesOverThresholdPercent, 
         MaxLagEver, AvgLag, P95Lag, P99Lag, CurrentLag, CurrentStatus,
         HistoricalPriorityScore, PriorityRecommendation, LagHistorySummary
queries.name: Query 8

content.json:
### Current State vs Historical Analysis (Subscription-Level)

Compare current lag status with historical patterns to identify subscriptions that may need Priority Blob Replication.

queries.query:
StorageGeoReplication_CL
| where ServiceType_s_s == "StorageGeoReplication"
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where IsGeoReplicated_b_b == true
| where HasReadAccess_b_b == true
| where isnotnull(LagMinutes_d_d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SubscriptionId_s_s, ResourceName_s_s
| summarize 
    SubscriptionId = any(SubscriptionId_s_s),
    TotalAccounts = count(),
    AccountsOverThreshold = countif(IsOverThreshold_b_b == true),
    AvgLag = round(avg(LagMinutes_d_d), 2),
    MaxLag = round(max(LagMinutes_d_d), 2),
    MinLag = round(min(LagMinutes_d_d), 2),
    MedianLag = round(percentile(LagMinutes_d_d, 50), 2),
    P95Lag = round(percentile(LagMinutes_d_d, 95), 2),
    TotalLagMinutes = round(sum(LagMinutes_d_d), 2)
    by SubscriptionId_s_s
| extend PriorityScore = round((AvgLag * 0.4) + (MaxLag * 0.3) + (AccountsOverThreshold * 10 * 0.3), 2)
| extend PriorityRecommendation = case(
    PriorityScore > 50, "🔴 High Priority - Consider Priority Blob Replication",
    PriorityScore > 20, "🟡 Medium Priority - Monitor Closely",
    PriorityScore > 10, "🟢 Low Priority - Standard Replication OK",
    "✅ Healthy - No Action Needed")
| order by PriorityScore desc, AvgLag desc
| project SubscriptionId, TotalAccounts, AccountsOverThreshold, AvgLag, MaxLag, MedianLag, P95Lag, PriorityScore, PriorityRecommendation
queries.name: Query 8

content.json:
### Resource Group & Storage Account Level Detail (Historical Analysis - Last 30 Days)

Drill down into specific resource groups and storage accounts. Shows historical lag patterns, not just current state.

queries.query:
let HistoricalData = StorageGeoReplication_CL
| where ServiceType_s_s == "StorageGeoReplication"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where IsGeoReplicated_b_b == true
| where HasReadAccess_b_b == true
| where isnotnull(LagMinutes_d_d);
let CurrentData = HistoricalData
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SubscriptionId_s_s, ResourceName_s_s;
HistoricalData
| summarize 
    SubscriptionId = any(SubscriptionId_s_s),
    ResourceGroup = any(ResourceGroup_s_s),
    ResourceName = any(ResourceName_s_s),
    Location = any(PrimaryLocation_s_s),
    SkuName = any(SkuName_s_s),
    ThresholdMinutes = any(ThresholdMinutes_d_d),
    TotalDataPoints = count(),
    TimesOverThreshold = countif(IsOverThreshold_b_b == true),
    TimesOverThresholdPercent = round((countif(IsOverThreshold_b_b == true) * 100.0 / count()), 1),
    MaxLagEver = round(max(LagMinutes_d_d), 2),
    AvgLag = round(avg(LagMinutes_d_d), 2),
    P95Lag = round(percentile(LagMinutes_d_d, 95), 2)
    by SubscriptionId_s_s, ResourceName_s_s
| join kind=inner (
    CurrentData
    | summarize CurrentLag = round(avg(LagMinutes_d_d), 2), 
              CurrentStatus = any(IsOverThreshold_b_b),
              LastSyncTime = any(LastSyncTime_t_s)
              by SubscriptionId_s_s, ResourceName_s_s
) on SubscriptionId_s_s, ResourceName_s_s
| extend LagCategory = case(
    MaxLagEver > 30, "Critical (Max >30 min)",
    MaxLagEver > 15, "High (Max 15-30 min)",
    MaxLagEver > 5, "Medium (Max 5-15 min)",
    MaxLagEver > 0, "Low (Max 0-5 min)",
    "No Lag")
| extend HistoricalIssue = case(
    TimesOverThresholdPercent > 30, "🔴 Frequent Lag Issues",
    TimesOverThresholdPercent > 15, "🟡 Occasional Lag Issues",
    MaxLagEver > 20, "🟡 High Lag Spikes",
    "✅ No Significant Issues")
| project SubscriptionId, ResourceGroup, ResourceName, Location, SkuName,
         CurrentLag, CurrentStatus, MaxLagEver, AvgLag, P95Lag,
         TimesOverThreshold, TimesOverThresholdPercent, ThresholdMinutes,
         LastSyncTime, LagCategory, HistoricalIssue
| order by SubscriptionId, MaxLagEver desc, TimesOverThresholdPercent desc
queries.name: Query 9

content.json:
### Subscription Lag Trend Over Time (Last 30 Days)

Track lag trends by subscription over the last 30 days to identify patterns and prioritize Priority Blob Replication.

queries.query:
StorageGeoReplication_CL
| where ServiceType_s_s == "StorageGeoReplication"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where IsGeoReplicated_b_b == true
| where HasReadAccess_b_b == true
| where isnotnull(LagMinutes_d_d)
| summarize 
    AvgLag = round(avg(LagMinutes_d_d), 2),
    MaxLag = round(max(LagMinutes_d_d), 2),
    P95Lag = round(percentile(LagMinutes_d_d, 95), 2)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), SubscriptionId_s_s
| extend SubscriptionId = SubscriptionId_s_s
| order by TimeGenerated asc, SubscriptionId asc
queries.name: Query 10
